newsitem.title: USA: American Rivers talking to job candidate.
newsitem.headline: American Rivers talking to job candidate.

text.p: American Rivers Oil Co said Friday discussions are underway with a candidate to be the company's new president.
American Rivers said the candicate is experienced in running an oil company in Denver with over $100 million in assets, but no agreement has been reached.

Upon the hiring of a new president, Karlton Terry intends to continue serving as chief executive officer, the company said, adding it does not intend the hiring of a new president to significantly increase its administrative expenses.

American Rivers said it has reached agreement with its existing officers for certain salary reductions, subject to appropriate terms. It said a discussion of the search efforts is included in its quarterly report on Form 1O-QSB filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission this week.
